suiseiThreeStarDraft.userDirection: Reduce maximum stars from 5 to 3 and retune related effects because targets often die before five stacks.

tier3.damage: 2d(8+floor(I/2))+5*S against marked target; base damage only against other targets

tier5.damage: 3d(10+floor(I/2))+8*S against snapshotted marked target; base damage only against other targets

suiseiThreeStarDraft.pietyMarkedKillBonus: Keep existing threshold S>=3: now requires full stacks. Other eligibility rules unchanged.
suiseiThreeStarDraft.visualProposal: Approved indicator now connected to ordinary gameplay: cyan1/2 and gold3 above marked enemy.

unapprovedPassiveCandidates.focusedObservation: If retained, ordinary accuracy +3 against marked target at S>=2; auto-hit and MR checks unaffected.
unapprovedPassiveCandidates.starInheritance: Retain user-preferred start at 2/3: only when existing kill-reward bonus hits a new marked target and it survives. Not implemented.

constraints: Faster full stacks are a real buff; maximum damage preserved approximately, not a balance-equivalence claim.
Keep original one-stack-per-damaging-action, exclusion, consumption, miss, expiry, friendly-fire and reward anti-recursion rules unless separately changed.
suiseiThreeStarDraft.saveMigration: Legacy v1 Suisei stars ceil(3*S/5), cap3; keep already-rolled reward and preserve +5/old-star bonus of already queued comets. New Suisei payload v2. Other gods remain v1.

suiseiFocusDraft.name: 집중 관측
suiseiFocusDraft.condition: Current marked target alive, mark unexpired, at least2of3 stars.
suiseiFocusDraft.effect: Accuracy +3 on attacks with ordinary hit checks, including melee/ranged and eligible attack spells. No damage bonus. Auto-hit attacks and MR checks unaffected.
suiseiFocusDraft.cost: No activation, MP, piety consumption, extra action or star consumption.
suiseiFocusDraft.scaling: Fixed +3; does not scale with Invocations or increase hit chance by a flat3 percentage points.
suiseiFocusDraft.visualDirection: Use the approved 2/3-star indicator to recognize eligibility; no new large effect required.

suiseiInheritance.name: 별의 계승
suiseiInheritance.effect: Consume the existing next-hit kill reward on a fresh marked foe. If the ordinary direct attack deals positive damage and the foe survives, start at2stars rather than1.
suiseiInheritance.cost: No additional MP/piety/action/star cost. Original attack/spell cost applies.
constraints: One-shot and reward-only kills give no inherited stars or recursive reward.
An already stacked target gains the normal1 only, max3.
Divine powers and DoT/pet damage do not trigger inheritance.
suiseiInheritance.save: Banked reward already uses saved offence/three_end fields; inheritance flag is per-action only. Native bank-save, actual next spell outcomes and strict ordinary-combat RNG continuation verified. Full post-targeting-UI RNG equality is logged separately.
